title: Dividing a module by its torsion in the ideal makes the local cohomology concentrate in degree zero
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the zeroth local cohomology of a module with support in a finitely generated ideal with the closed subscheme version, and shows that after dividing by the common torsion submodule the local cohomology concentrates in degree zero while the higher cohomology is unchanged (author lemma at source lines 2111-2123, label lemma-divide-by-torsion). The proof (source lines 2125-2143) computes the zeroth cohomology as a kernel of localizations, reads off torsionness and the vanishing of the higher cohomology of the torsion submodule from the adjoint description, and uses the torsion freeness of the quotient together with the long exact cohomology sequence (proof lines 2138-2142). The comparison of the two zeroth cohomologies is the substance. H3.
